topics: Formulation of design problems as mathematical programming problems
Classical optimization: unconstrained single and multivariate optimization
Linear, Mathematical formulation of LP Problems
Solving using Simplex method and Graphical method
Graphical solution (2x n, m x 2 game)
Introduction to network tree - Minimal Spanning Tree - Prim’s Algorithm
Shortest path problems- Solution methods – Dijkstra’s Method
Single variable optimization methods- Fibonacci search method
Multi-variable methods- Hook-Jeeves pattern search method
GA operators: Encoding, Crossover, Selection, Mutation

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks. Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered. Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Formulate the real world problem as Linear Programming Problem
Apply different methods of Game Theory, Network Tree and Shortest Path.
Find solutions for Nonlinear unconstrained optimization problems
Apply modern methods of optimization for solving optimization problems.
